versions.changelog:
v1.0.0 — First publication.

Initial release. Ports the operating doctrine for Facebook Page automation
from a regulated-field operation to a domain-agnostic skill.

Includes:
- Pages-only doctrine (explicit rules against personal-profile + third-party-group
  automation — the fast-track to permanent ban)
- 3-role mental model (fb-post / fb-engage / fb-stealth)
- MBS-first — never automate facebook.com directly
- Page Quality-aware phase gating (Phase A/B) with manual override path
- Zero-outgoing-link policy in comments; max 1 URL in DMs
- Page moderation discipline (Hide vs Delete vs Ban; prefer Hide)
- The MBS comment-Reply navigation-bug workaround (shared with IG)
- 24h Messenger window awareness; out-of-window outbound needs message-tag
  templates (out of scope here)
- Strict reply qualification (skip testimonials-without-link, recognize existing
  clients, 7-day per-user cap)
- Hard quotas calibrated to avoid Page Quality drops
- "Posting as: Page" toggle drift check
- Recovery playbook for Page Quality drops, Page restrictions, admin-account
  "in review", comment automod removals
- 9-file memory inventory (including fb-banned-users.md) + first-run checklist + FAQ

Companion to instagram-account-operations (same MBS backbone, IG-specific
doctrine) and to the reddit / twitter / tiktok / whatsapp family.
